columns.estimator: maximum axial gap between adjacent oxygens of the column
columns.missing_means: fewer than two waters in the pore

columns.name: ww_continuous
columns.estimator: 1 if max_gap < coordination cutoff (first minimum of the ion–water g(r))
columns.missing_means: fewer than two waters in the pore

columns.estimator: mean cos of the water dipole to the axis; sign-bearing, hence canonized

columns.missing_means: fewer than two waters in the pore

columns.name: occ_n_ions_pore
columns.estimator: number of permeant ions in the pore cylinder within the bin range (indicator for ion-conditional columns)

columns.name: occ_has_innermost
columns.estimator: the measured object (ion nearest to the constriction) exists: an ion is in the pore AND the constriction is measured (companion indicator of a composite object)

columns.name: occ_innermost_z_A
columns.estimator: axial offset of the constriction-nearest ion from the anchor; structural coordinate
columns.missing_means: no innermost ion (no ion in pore, or constriction not measured)

columns.name: occ_innermost_dz_constr_A
columns.estimator: |ion z − constriction z| for the innermost ion

columns.name: occ_innermost_coord_n
columns.estimator: water oxygens in the first shell of the innermost ion (cutoff at the first minimum of g(r))

columns.name: occ_desolvation
columns.estimator: 1 − coord_n/bulk_coord_n: desolvation degree of the innermost ion; bulk is the median coordination of ions outside the pore in the same frame
columns.missing_means: no innermost ion, or no ions outside the pore for the bulk reference

columns.name: ns_filter_n_ions

columns.name: ns_S0_occ

columns.missing_means: no filter, or site beyond the ring count (structural mask)

columns.name: ns_S1_occ
columns.estimator: soft occupancy of a named filter site: Σ exp(−(z−z_s)²/2σ²); the center is the midpoint between adjacent oxygen rings of the motif, per frame

columns.name: ele_pot_protein_cut12_e_per_A
columns.estimator: Σ q_j/r_ij over atoms of class 'protein' within 12 A of the constriction-nearest ion; the cutoff is part of the name

columns.name: ele_pot_water_cut12_e_per_A
columns.estimator: Σ q_j/r_ij over atoms of class 'water' within 12 A of the constriction-nearest ion; the cutoff is part of the name

columns.name: ele_pot_ions_cut12_e_per_A
columns.estimator: Σ q_j/r_ij over atoms of class 'ions' within 12 A of the constriction-nearest ion; the cutoff is part of the name

columns.name: ele_pot_lipid_cut12_e_per_A
columns.estimator: Σ q_j/r_ij over atoms of class 'lipid' within 12 A of the constriction-nearest ion; the cutoff is part of the name

columns.name: ele_axial_charge_asym_e
columns.estimator: total charge of mobile particles in the cylinder above the constriction minus below; sign-carrying → canonicalized

columns.name: sym_com_radial_spread_A
columns.estimator: std of radial offsets of subunit centers of mass from the axis

columns.name: sym_com_z_spread_A
columns.estimator: std of axial coordinates of subunit centers of mass; for a dimer, ×2 gives the axial interface gap (gating by dissociation)

columns.name: sym_nn_dist_cv
columns.estimator: coefficient of variation of distances between circularly adjacent subunits

columns.name: sym_com_z_spread_rel
columns.estimator: subunit COM z-spread as a fraction of the bin range — system-relative form of sym_com_z_spread_A (absolute spreads scale with pore length and screen out as system labels)

columns.name: flu_water_pore_var_win
columns.estimator: variance of hyd_water_pore_n over the strictly backward window

columns.name: flu_ion_pore_var_win
columns.estimator: variance of occ_n_ions_pore over the strictly backward window

columns.name: flu_r_constr_var_win
columns.estimator: variance of geo_r_constriction_A over the window (measured frames only)
columns.missing_means: no measured radius values in the window

columns.name: dyn_ion_persist
columns.estimator: the drift's measured object exists: the current innermost ion was in the pore at the window start as well (companion indicator)

columns.name: dyn_ion_drift_A_win
columns.estimator: axial displacement of the current constriction-nearest ion over the backward window; requires the ion to have been in the pore at the window start too; sign-carrying → canonicalized
columns.missing_means: ion not in the pore now, or was not at the window start

columns.name: dyn_wet_state_age_ps
columns.estimator: time in the current wet/dry state (from hyd_min_bin_water_n>0)

columns.name: dyn_occ_change_age_ps
columns.estimator: time since the last change of occ_n_ions_pore

columns.name: dlv_n_upper_mouth
columns.estimator: permeant ions in the upper mouth zone (radius mouth_radius, depth mouth_depth)

columns.name: dlv_n_lower_mouth
columns.estimator: permeant ions in the lower mouth zone

columns.name: dlv_n_entry_mouth
columns.estimator: permeant ions in the ENTRY mouth zone (the side set by the conduction direction)

columns.name: dlv_entry_wide_n
columns.estimator: permeant ions in the wide entry zone (3×mouth_radius) — indicator

columns.name: dlv_dist_entry_A
columns.estimator: distance from the entry-mouth center to the nearest permeant outside the pore
columns.missing_means: no permeant in the wide entry zone

columns.name: dlv_approach_pair_n
columns.estimator: at how many window endpoints (0..2, end ≠ start) the entry distance is measured (companion indicator of the approach)

columns.name: dlv_approach_A_win
columns.estimator: approach of the nearest permeant toward the entry over the backward window: dist(t−window)−dist(t)
columns.missing_means: distance not measured at one of the window endpoints

columns.name: dlv_t_since_cross_ps
columns.estimator: time since the last completed crossing in this trajectory
columns.missing_means: before the trajectory's first crossing the measured object does not exist

columns.name: dlv_crossed_before
columns.estimator: whether a completed crossing has already occurred in this trajectory (indicator)

columns.name: dlv_rate_win
columns.estimator: rate of completed crossings in the backward window

columns.name: bl_rao_E_kJmol
columns.estimator: dewetting energy from the vendored Rao-2019 surface as a function of (lining hydrophobicity, constriction radius) — PER FRAME; a declared deviation from the paper (the authors define the inputs on time averages)
columns.missing_means: inputs not measured on this frame

columns.name: bl_rao_E_win_kJmol
columns.estimator: the same surface on inputs averaged over a backward window — the version comparable to the authors' averaging; its difference from the per-frame value measures how justified the transfer is
columns.missing_means: no measured inputs in the window

columns.name: bl_rao_sigma_d
columns.estimator: the published Rao-2019 STRUCTURE score: every pore-facing residue (CHAP rule, COG within local radius + 7.5 A margin) contributes a (kernel-smoothed hydrophobicity, local radius) point; points past the 1RT contour by the authors' nearest-node rule contribute their distance to it; the paper calls sigma_d > 0.55 non-conductive
columns.missing_means: no pore-facing residue points measured on this frame

columns.name: bl_rao_flag_n
columns.estimator: number of residue points past the 1RT contour (indicator)
columns.missing_means: no pore-facing residue points measured on this frame

n_columns_is_derived: len(columns); a literal count is forbidden
